lines_greet_ru: О, покупатель! Или продавец? Не важно, клади.
У Петровича всё берут и всё сдают.
Заходи, не стесняйся, цены всё равно смешные.
lines_greet_en: Put it down. I buy anything. Cheap.
Oh, a buyer! Or a seller? Doesn't matter, put it down.
Petrovich buys all, Petrovich pays little.
You again. Fine, show me.
Whatcha got? Not much. Right.
Come in, don't be shy, the prices are a joke anyway.
lines_scream_ru: Ты мне это на прилавок положил?!
Такого я ещё не видел. И не хотел.
За это мне ещё и платить?!
lines_scream_en: What is that? WHAT IS THAT?!
You put THAT on my counter?!
Oh. Oh no. Well, fine.
Never seen one of those. Didn't want to.
It's dirty too!
And I'm supposed to PAY for this?!
lines_deal_en: Deal. Don't come crying later.
I'll take it. No idea where I'll put it.
Fine, fine. Your price.
Deal! Petrovich is pleased.
Here's your pennies. That's all I've got.
Sold. I mean, bought.
lines_reject_ru: У меня ларёк, а не казино.
Я за такое сам приплачивать не буду.
lines_reject_en: That much? For THIS? Ha.
You're confusing me with a bank.
Drop a zero. Or two.
This is a stall, not a casino.
No-no-no. Less.
I'm not paying extra for THAT.
lines_phobia_ru: Я на стол залезу! Я серьёзно!
lines_phobia_en: MOUSE! MOUSE! GET IT AWAY!
AAAH! It's moving!
I'll climb on the table! I mean it!
Take the rodent and leave!
Petrovich scared. Petrovich not paying.

lines_greet_ru: Ах. Ещё один охотник за сокровищами.
Осторожнее с прилавком, ему двести лет.
Добро пожаловать. Пыль не трогать, она антикварная.
lines_greet_en: Ah. Another treasure hunter.
Mind the counter, it's two hundred years old.
Show me what you've... dragged in.
Porcelain? Papers? Or junk again?
Welcome. Don't touch the dust, it's antique.
I shall appraise. You shall be disappointed.
lines_scream_ru: Скол! Тут скол! Я его вижу!
Это... это не то, о чём я подумал?
Осторожно! Оно дышит историей и плесенью!
lines_scream_en: You WASHED it?! Barbarian!
A chip! There's a chip! I see it!
Good heavens. Someone loved this.
Is that... is that what I think it is?
Careful! It breathes history and mold!
Ah! My monocle!
lines_deal_ru: Беру. Это войдёт в коллекцию. Или в подвал.
Ваша цена оскорбительна, но я согласен.
lines_deal_en: Acceptable. Let's proceed.
Agreed. Now stop touching things.
I'll take it. It joins the collection. Or the basement.
Fine. For art's sake.
Your price is offensive, but I accept.
Purchased. Leave quietly.
lines_reject_ru: Вы оцениваете по весу? Это не сыр.
Нет. Ещё раз нет. И — нет.
За такую цену продайте это музею. Плохому.
lines_reject_en: That is not Ming. That is Minsk.
Are you pricing by weight? It's not cheese.
No. Again, no. And also no.
At that price, sell it to a museum. A bad one.
I'm an antiquarian, not a charity.
Amusing. No.
lines_phobia_ru: У меня аллергия на скотч. Душевная.
Кто-то заклеил историю! Кто-то заклеил ИСТОРИЮ!
lines_phobia_en: DUCT TAPE?! On an antique?! Out!
Remove that sticky abomination!
I'm allergic to tape. Spiritually.
Someone taped over history! TAPED OVER HISTORY!
This is a crime against restoration!

lines_greet_ru: Привет! Комоды есть? Комоды всегда надо.
Заезжай! Чистое беру дороже, грязное — тоже беру.
О, руки в масле! Мой человек.
Тащи сюда. Если пролезет в дверь — куплю.
lines_greet_en: Hey there! Got dressers? Always need dressers.
Roll on in! Clean stuff pays more, dirty stuff still pays.
Oh, oily hands! My kind of person.
Drag it in. If it fits through the door, I buy it.
Furniture? Dishes? A bucket? All mine.
Howdy! Did grandma clean it? No? Pity.
lines_scream_ru: Это ж пылью на палец! На палец!
Ой, ножка отвалилась. Твоя ножка. То есть его.
Ты это на чём вёз? На себе?!
lines_scream_en: The drawer won't open! THE DRAWER!
That's a finger of dust! A FINGER!
Whoa. Whoa-ho. Where do I put that?
Is that a sofa or an animal?!
Oops, a leg fell off. Your leg. I mean its leg.
What did you haul that on? Your back?!
lines_deal_ru: Беру. В подсобку. Там ещё сорок таких.
Куплю. Ставь к тем комодам. Да, к тем.
lines_deal_en: Deal! Help me carry it.
I'll take it. Back room. There's forty more like it.
Works for me. I love a clean one.
Alright, deal. No more scratches though.
Buying. Put it by those dressers. Yes, those.
Deal! Want a discount on a mop?
lines_reject_ru: Э, столько стоит новый. С доставкой.
Дорого. У меня таких три и все не продаются.
Не-не. Это ж ДСП. ДСП, понимаешь?
За такое я тебе сам дам… в долг.
Ты цену где взял? На потолке?
lines_reject_en: Hey, that's what a NEW one costs. With delivery.
Wash it first, then haggle.
Too much. I've got three and none of them sell.
Nah-nah. That's particleboard. PARTICLEBOARD.
For that I'd rather lend you money.
Where'd you get that price? The ceiling?
lines_phobia_ru: Убери банку! У меня новый пол!
Я это отмывал три недели в прошлый раз!
lines_phobia_en: PAINT! It gets EVERYWHERE!
Take the can away! I just did the floors!
No-no-no, don't open it! DON'T OPEN IT!
Last time I scrubbed for three weeks!
Paint is forever! Like a mother-in-law!

lines_greet_en: Does it turn on? No? Still interested.
Plasma? Laptop? Or a toaster again?
Put it on the anti-static mat. Right there.
Ooh! Hardware! Let me see!
Warranty expired in 2009? Perfect, I'll take it.
Don't touch the cables. The cables are mine.
lines_scream_ru: Кто-то это ронял. Много раз. С любовью.
lines_scream_en: The screen! Spiderweb screen!
The battery's swollen! It's PREGNANT!
Someone dropped this. Repeatedly. With love.
Smells burnt! I love it!
That's a CRT! Mind your back!
Oh. It beeped. It's alive.
lines_deal_ru: Беру. На запчасти. Или на алтарь.
Договорились. Кабель в подарок. Не тот.
Годно. Ставь к серверу. Это не сервер, но ставь.
lines_deal_en: Taking it. For parts. Or the shrine.
Okay. I'll reflash it and sell it for triple.
Deal. Free cable. Not the right one.
Good. Put it by the server. It's not a server, but still.
Deal. I won't ask for the password.
Bought. Your data? Not anymore.
lines_reject_ru: Столько стоит новый. И он работает.
Ты ноль лишний нажал. Как на клавиатуре.
lines_reject_en: For an iPhon 4S? It's not 2011.
It doesn't even power on. Lower it.
Nope. The capacitors are crying.
That's the price of a new one. That works.
You hit an extra zero. Like on a keyboard.
Nah. It's a Samsong, not the real one.
lines_phobia_ru: МОКРОЕ! Не неси мокрое к железу!
Убери! Я и так на рисе живу!
lines_phobia_en: WET! Don't bring wet stuff near hardware!
Water! Short circuit! I'm doomed!
Wipe it! WIPE IT before it smokes!
It's dripping! On the MOTHERBOARD!
Get it away! I already live on rice!

lines_greet_ru: Тихо. Клади. Не смотри мне в глаза.
Вопросов не задаю. Ты тоже не задавай.
Что принёс? Хорошее — это то, что не ищут.
lines_greet_en: Quiet. Put it down. Don't look me in the eye.
I ask no questions. You ask none either.
You again. Anyone tail you? Check.
Whatcha got? Good stuff is stuff nobody's looking for.
Come in. Close the door. Both of them.
Well? Show me what you «found».
lines_scream_ru: Ты это где взял? Не отвечай.
О-о. Это ж Сержа. Был Сержа.
Убери со света! Со света убери!
lines_scream_en: That has a serial number?! File it off!
Quiet-quiet-quiet! That's... yeah.
Where'd you get that? Don't answer.
Oh-ho. That's Serge's. WAS Serge's.
Get it out of the light! Out of the light!
Heh. Heh-heh. I like it.
lines_deal_ru: Беру. Деньги в конверте. Конверта нет.
Ладно. Но ты меня не знаешь.
lines_deal_en: Deal. We never met.
I'll take it. Cash in an envelope. No envelope.
Fine. But you don't know me.
Deal. Wash your hands after.
Done. You were never here.
Buying. Say it was a gift.
lines_reject_ru: За такое я ещё и риск беру. Скидывай.
Ты на кого работаешь? Шучу. Не шучу. Скидывай.
lines_reject_en: You want a lot. You'll live a little.
I'm taking the risk here. Lower it.
Nah. Too clean. Suspicious.
Half. Or the door is that way.
Who do you work for? Kidding. Not kidding. Lower it.
Not funny. Less.
lines_phobia_ru: У меня было детство. Там был хомяк. Не спрашивай.
Нет-нет-нет. Не этот. Не эти щёки.
lines_phobia_en: HAMSTER! Get the hamster away! I mean it!
It's looking at me! It KNOWS!
I had a childhood. There was a hamster. Don't ask.
No-no-no. Not that one. Not those cheeks.
That's it, no deal. Hamster out.
